label: Lava Tube
literalRoomDescription: You are in a tight chimney of solidified lava. It extends up at least another hundred feet and down to a large room far below. A large crack opens to the south, probably the result of a shift in the rock strata.
safeSceneProfile: Tight solidified-lava chimney extending over one hundred feet, large southern crack and room far below. Vertical movement uses source options, not gravity teleportation.
